name: Chidambaram

queries.query: Chidambaram Tamil Nadu official cadastral parcel map GIS survey land records
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Tamil Nadu e-Services land-record portal, TamilNilam Geo-Info, TNGLMS, and the official Cuddalore District Survey page. The Cuddalore page identifies the district Survey and Land Records office as custodian/administrator for Chidambaram division and says A-Register, Chitta, FMB, Natham and town records are computerized through TamilNilam. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.
